prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One fully NEW and reimagined StarNet game prop. Reference 1 is approved crate: exact finish/readability standard. Reference 2 is approved workstation: exact camera and craft. Reference 3 is approved bridge: world context. Use these solely as style references. Do not copy the crate or desk silhouette. South-facing overhead oblique station camera, perfectly straight-on in horizontal alignment, NO yaw, no isometric diagonals: horizontal long edges, vertical supports, symmetrical foreshortening, top planes visible at the same angle as workstation reference. Worn cool charcoal steel, broad readable panels, deep recesses, sparse purposeful brass/amber edge wear. Retain clear major parts at tiny game scale; no overly intricate micro-machinery, no arbitrary blue paint or bright chrome. Entire single prop isolated with generous margin and true transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, floor, room, text, other props, label or framing. Design a small PORTABLE TOOL CADDY, a single-tile hand-carried open tool box. Entire silhouette approximately square, its full HEIGHT about HALF a workstation, tiny relative to a person. Fresh design: squat trapezoidal charcoal open bin with a stout elevated central carry handle on two supports. Inside, exactly three readable tool silhouettes: a short open-ended spanner, thick screwdriver handle, and folded pliers, staggered but contained. Broad rim and reinforced near face, practical matte metal details, muted worn edges. Recognizable hand tools, NO mechanical control console, no machinery cabinets, no monitors or glow. Tool handles charcoal and dull brown-black, steel tips small. Readable open negative space under the carrying handle. Do not compress an elaborate workshop into a tiny prop.
